ko.executive_summary: AI data center demand is driving strong growth across CPO and optical communications suppliers. Coherent has launched PhotonLink for AI data centers, while Marvell and Semtech posted earnings beats on data center strength, with Semtech capturing $100M in AI data center revenue. Silicon photonics technology is increasingly recognized as a critical enabler for AI computing infrastructure.
key_facts: Coherent (COHR) unveiled PhotonLink for AI data centers
Semtech generated $100M in AI data center demand
Marvell Technology beat Q2 and Q4 earnings on data center boom and custom AI chips
Silicon photonics identified as key technology for AI computing

implications.text: Sustained demand from AI data centers is validating CPO/optical solutions as essential to scaling inference and training workloads, evidenced by multiple suppliers posting earnings beats.
PhotonLink launch positions Coherent as a key player in optical interconnect solutions for AI, though stock upside may already be reflected in valuation.
Increasing recognition of silicon photonics as a foundational technology suggests accelerating system-level integration of optical capabilities in AI infrastructure.
Concentration of wins (Coherent, Marvell, Semtech) indicates competitive pressure on suppliers to demonstrate AI/CPO-specific capabilities and custom solutions.

ko.counterpoint: While earnings and revenue growth are strong, sustainability depends on continued hyperscaler capex cycles and whether Coherent's PhotonLink gains meaningful design wins at scale.
